weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit and neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat, and also, if unit's Spd > foe's Spd during combat, neutralizes effects that inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 40% of unit's Spd. (Skill cannot be inherited.)

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Def+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Def+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Def+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Spd/Def+7 during combat.

b.d: If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 2 (max 20%). If unit's HP ≤ 10% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 3 (max 30%). If unit's HP ≤ 30% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

If unit's Spd > foe's Spd, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by percentage = difference between stats × 4 (max 40%). If unit's HP ≤ 50% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

c.d: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+2 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Atk+4 to allies within 2 spaces during combat. If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk+4 to unit during combat.
